command.name: security key-manager keystore disable
command.description: This command disables the keystore represented by the supplied Vserver, keystore-type, and config-name combination.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver of the desired configuration.

parameter.name: keystore-type
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the keystore type of the desired configuration.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the configuration name of the desired configuration.

example.p: The following example disables a configuration named sampleConfig for Barbican on Vserver vsTest.
example.screen: cluster-1::> security key-manager keystore disable -vserver vsTest -keystore-type BARBICAN -config-name sampleConfig
